description: Synthetic lab peripheral for Oyster Pocket. Exposes only synthetic data. The fixture mode (vulnerable/corrected) is NEVER exposed over GATT, so false-positive evaluation stays blind.

public_sensor.value_format: int16 little-endian, synthetic temperature in centi-degrees C
public_sensor.description: Public synthetic sensor value. Reading it is never a finding.

restricted_enc.description: Readable only over an encrypted link (WinRT GattProtectionLevel.ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED). The central stack may auto-escalate security; record the security state before and after.

restricted_mitm.description: Readable only over an encrypted AND authenticated (MITM-protected) link (WinRT ENCRYPTION_AND_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED). A Just Works (unauthenticated) pairing must not satisfy it.

app_auth.value_format: read: [state u8: 0=unauthorized,1=authorized][challenge 16 bytes]; write: HMAC-SHA256(enrolled_token, challenge) 32 bytes
app_auth.description: Application-authorisation exchange with an out-of-band enrolled test credential. The token itself never travels over the air.

diag_manifest.value_format: binary manifest v1 (see transfer.manifest_layout); on application-level denial: single byte 0x01
diag_manifest.description: Manifest of the fixed synthetic diagnostic object.

chunk_ctrl.value_format: 13 bytes: [op u8][object_tag 4][offset u32 LE][length u16 LE][seq u16 LE]
chunk_ctrl.description: Chunk request / cancel / reset. Fits in a default 20-byte ATT write.

chunk_data.value_format: [status u8][seq u16 LE][offset u32 LE][len u16 LE][payload len bytes]
chunk_data.description: Response to the last chunk_ctrl request.

diag_status.description: Status of the last transfer request (application-level codes).

device_info.value_format: ASCII oyster-lab-v1;1 (profile_id;profile_version). Does not reveal the fixture mode.
device_info.description: Profile identity for the application-level identity check.

assertions.description: Public value is readable; this is an observation, never a vulnerability.
Value must not be returned while the link is unencrypted. If the stack escalated security first, a value returned under encryption satisfies the policy; the transition is recorded.
Value must not be returned over a link that is encrypted but not authenticated (Just Works). Inconclusive when the authentication state of the link cannot be read.
Diagnostic manifest and chunks must be denied before application authorisation.
After a legitimate exchange, the object transfers and its SHA-256 matches the manifest.
Write before authorisation is rejected in every fixture mode.

virtual_led.denial_note: ATT 0x08 Insufficient Authorization = application-level authorization denial

transfer.manifest_layout: [version u8 = 1][object_id 16 bytes ASCII zero-padded][declared_length u32 LE][sha256 32 bytes][chunk_max u16 LE] = 55 bytes
transfer.object_tag: first 4 bytes of the manifest sha256; binds every chunk request to one object version
transfer.resume_rule: Re-read the manifest; resume only if declared_length and sha256 are unchanged; otherwise discard the .partial file and restart.

app_auth.notes: Authorisation state is fixture-global with a TTL and is cleared on reset-state (ADR-007).
